mapper.sql: id, person_id AS personId, name, intro, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (person_id, name, intro) VALUES (#{personId}, #{name}, #{intro})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.category_type AS categoryType FROM story_category c JOIN role_story_category_rel r ON c.id = r.story_category_id WHERE r.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY c.sort, c.id
SELECT id, person_id AS personId, name, intro, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM role WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT r.id, r.person_id AS personId, r.name, r.intro, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM role r JOIN person p ON r.person_id = p.id WHERE p.name_cn = #{nameCn} LIMIT 1
